critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 10073 lines (grew ~140 from iter34) — split into routers (admin, sessions, members, security) is overdue.

_send_session_absent_followups runs daily via APScheduler; the window is sessions dated between today-3 and today-1. If the daily job misfires or the server was down, sessions older than 3 days are skipped forever. Consider widening to today-7 (bounded by noshow_emails idempotency) for resiliency, or add an admin manual trigger endpoint similar to /admin/programs/{pid}/noshow-followup.

_next_open_session uses date > sess['date'] when today<=sess['date'], but typical case the session is in the past so after=today works. Minor: label 'start_date' in the email dict uses nxt['date'] (good), but the end_time formatting path uses '_fmt_time(nxt['end_time'])' without a null guard inside the ternary — currently safe because of the preceding 'if nxt.get("start_time")' check, but keep in mind.

WalkInIn pydantic model lacks max_length on name/email/phone — server does truncation (name[:120], email[:200], phone[:30]) but model would accept 10MB string first. Consider pydantic Field constraints.
spot_tokens table has no TTL index; tokens for past sessions accumulate. Consider TTL on created_at or a daily sweep.
SessionInsights.jsx — Pill.rows[0].rate becomes NaN if marked[].attended+no_show===0 for a bucket; guarded by marked = sessions.filter((s)=>s.attended+s.no_show>0) so fine.
AdminOverview grid is lg:grid-cols-2 but currently renders only SpamCard — right half is empty on wide screens. UI will balance once more cards are added, not blocking.
